chapter: Chicago, Virginia Ravens and the northern territory bands
title: Learning chords, Frankie Trumbauer's style and starting to write
summary: Hines bought him a Trumbauer record; he collected Trumbauer's recordings, copied his alto style, studied a banjo book for chords and began arranging.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: So he bought me a record of Frankie Trumbauer Trombaer singing the Blues." And I fell in love with that style so I started buying all the things that Frankie Trumbauer made, that he made
with Bix and Ed Lang and Miff Mole and Jimmy Dorsey, different ones. But I bought everything because of Frankie Trumbauer. And I learned his style on alto.

Then I bought me a banjo book, A McNeills (PHONETIC) Banjo book, and learned the cycle of the 5th, and chords, and I practiced all these on my saxophone. So now this improved my playing very much. Then I got interested in writing and I started to write a little bit, you know.
But anyway, along -- we played with the Virginia Ravens all that summer.
